tweet.text:
The final review is underway. 🚀

We’re currently completing the final verification of code submissions and evaluation data for the Agent Memory Leaderboard.

After reviewing 136+ memory systems from the community, we’re excited to share the first results on August 12.

The response has been beyond our expectations:

• 100,000+ visits to the leaderboard website
• 100+ submissions from developers and researchers
• Discussions across global AI communities
• Attention from builders, researchers, and industry voices
Thank you to everyone who participated, shared feedback, and supported this initiative.
Memory is becoming a critical layer for the next generation of AI agents.
We can’t wait to share the results soon.

Explore the leaderboard:
 https://huggingface.co/spaces/agent-memory-leaderboard/leaderboard
